entry.title: Reinforcement learning guidance for low-cost counter-UAS interceptors
entry.summary: We propose a reinforcement learning guidance law for low-cost interceptors used in counter-UAS defence against small drones. In simulation, the policy reduces miss distance against manoeuvring targets compared with proportional navigation. We discuss limits for field use.

entry.title: Thermal modelling of hypersonic glide vehicle leading edges with ceramic matrix composites
entry.summary: We present a thermal model of leading edges for hypersonic glide vehicles made of ceramic matrix composites, validated on arc-jet test data. The study supports material selection for interceptor and glide vehicle research.
